entries.userVisibleSummary: Keiko can ship as three portable downloads with bundled Node, managed first-run setup, one-click in-app updates for portable-managed installs, and no competing browser-managed install prompt.

stateImpact.description: Portable first-run setup records a content-free managed install attestation so future launches and updates can distinguish managed user-owned installs from bootstrap, unmanaged, or machine-managed locations.

Portable update sessions persist content-free download, staging, activation, relaunch, and version-verification status so interrupted updates can resume without storing package payloads, customer content, private paths, prompts, model output, raw logs, or secrets.
Release-impact remediation remains the source of truth after portable activation; full update completion waits until required local follow-up work completes or is safely deferred.

releaseNoteBullets: Adds portable Keiko downloads for Windows x64, macOS arm64, and macOS x64 with bundled Node, managed first-run setup, one-click in-app updates for portable-managed installs, and no competing browser-managed install prompt.

review.rationale: Program #1944 integrates #1942 portable runtime/setup and #1945 portable updater v2 on one program branch before the final #1961 QA gate and dev PR. The release note records the user-visible portable product delivery path while keeping signing secret names, CI internals, raw logs, private paths, and package payload details out of default notes; release-owner approval is recorded in PR review #4606286126.

review.rationale: Issue #1996 records the user-visible regression and the local release-owner decision to ship an immediate 0.2.14 patch after reproducing the failure and verifying the fix against a copied affected Local Knowledge store; release-owner authority is recorded in PR review #4618551973 and 0.2.14 publication was explicitly authorized locally in this Codex session.

entries.userVisibleSummary: Beta preview of the governed Coding Workbench: Governed Assist, Supervised Coding, and Autonomous Delivery autonomy modes with managed sidecar runtime support, plus governed GitHub/Jira coding-context intake and automated portable asset staging from approved runtime inputs.

Beta previews the Coding Workbench epic (PR #2126) plus the #2152 release-automation and connector-wiring follow-up; publication uses the beta dist-tag only and does not affect latest.
